description: This file defines a React functional component named 'FormWizard' that implements a multi-step form with validation, stepper navigation, review mode with editing capabilities, and consent gating. It manages form state, validation logic, step navigation, and user interactions to provide a guided user input experience.

methods.name: validateStep
methods.description: Validates the current or specified step's fields, updates errors state, and returns a boolean indicating validity.

methods.name: computeS1
methods.description: Computes validity of step 1 fields (Account) based on username, password, and confirm password.

methods.name: computeS2
methods.description: Computes validity of step 2 fields (Profile) including firstName, lastName, email.

methods.name: computeS3
methods.description: Computes validity of step 3 fields (Preferences) including topic and delivery frequency.

methods.name: canProceed()
methods.description: Determines if the form can proceed to the next step based on current step's validation state.
